messages.author: 8aa9b8cc06fdc99c
messages.subject: Re: [stan-users] output from ordinal_logistic_log function
parts:
I'm happy to see people running sanity checks on outputs.

I believe Heemun thought the following would lead to
pr2 being assigned a simplex (sequence of non-negative
values summing to 1):

> for (k in 1:K) {
> logodd[k] <- ordered_logistic_log(k, x_new * beta, c);
> pr2[k] <- inv_logit(logodd[k]);
> }

The problem is that logodd[k] is not the log odds, it's the
plain old log of the ordered logistic probability mass function.
The "logistic" in the name of the function is that it's
an ordered logistic regression that's being used to parameterize
the probability mass function.

What you want is something like this:

logpr[k] <- ordered_logistic_log(k, x_new * beta, c);
pr2[k] <- exp(logpr[k]);
}

- Bob

P.S. Your mailer thinks it's the future.

messages.author: dd60e3881f7a4dcf
messages.subject: output from ordinal_logistic_log function
parts:
Hello,
First of all, thanks for putting together this great package. I am
getting strange results from the ordered_logistic_log function--the
probabilities (vector "pr2") do not sum to 1. When I explicitly
generate the category probabilities ("pr"), the results seem correct
(they are similar to polr function from MASS). The code is modified
from the Stan Reference Model. Am I misunderstanding this function?
Here is the code, output and sessionInfo (the data are in the attached
Rdata file).

Thanks in advance,
Heemun


politic_code <- '
data {
int<lower=1> D; //number of predictors
int<lower=2> K; //number of categories
int<lower=0> N; //number of observations
int<lower=1,upper=K> y[N]; //ordinal response
row_vector[D] x[N]; //predictor vector
row_vector[D] x_new; //new predictor vector
}
parameters {
vector[D] beta;
ordered[K-1] c;
}
model {
for (n in 1:N)
y[n] ~ ordered_logistic(x[n] * beta, c); //mu[n] = x[n]*beta
}
generated quantities {
vector[K-1] Q; //cumul prob (for k>=i)
simplex[K] pr; //prob for each category given x_new
vector[K] logodd;
vector<lower=0, upper=1> [K] pr2; //vector of prob each category

for (k in 1:K){
logodd[k] <- ordered_logistic_log(k, x_new * beta, c);
pr2[k] <- inv_logit(logodd[k]);
}


for (i in 1:K-1)
Q[i] <- inv_logit(x_new * beta - c[i]);

//Extract category probabilities
pr[1] <- 1 - Q[1]; //lowest cat
for (k in 2:(K-1)) //intermediate cat
pr[k] <- Q[k-1] - Q[k];
pr[K] <- Q[K-1]; //highest cat
}
'

politic_fit <- stan(model_code = politic_code, data = politic_dat, iter
= 1000, chains = 1, seed=1)
